article.title: Genocide and the slow erosion of the family in Gaza
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: In scattered tents across Gaza, families once bound by shared meals and evenings by the sea now focus solely on survival. The rituals that once bonded fathers to their children, or women to their neighbors, have been shattered by Israel's genocide.
